Closing drift by machine instead of by hand: a drift finding becomes a typed task in ServiceNow, SailPoint Identity Security Cloud acts on it within its approval ceiling, the result is re-read from the source, and every step leaves an evidence record. Includes the integration example and an internal task catalog.

Work down the page: understand the design, plan it, build it, learn it, watch it, download it, and keep the evidence. [All topics](index.md) lists the others.
